scope: Selected primary-source case studies, not all successful traders or an audit of anyone's private account. Evidence of a mechanism does not establish its availability at100USD.

cases.name: Virtu Financial — market making
cases.reported_measure: Whole-company GAAP net income912.3millionUSD for2025; do not call adjusted trading income2,145.3million netprofit
cases.payer_mechanism: Customers seeking immediacy trade with a principal liquidity provider; realized spread and inventory/hedging results, less costs, contribute to income
cases.required_capabilities: Capital commitment, cross-venue execution, hedging and operational infrastructure
cases.transferability: Business proof, not a recipe for100-dollarAMMspot returns; report spans cash/futures/options and multipleassetclasses
cases.failure_modes: Adverse selection, inventory gaps, market-access/technology and hedging failures
cases.fa: سود رسمی گزارش‌شده شرکت واقعی است، اما سود کل شرکت با بازده یک حساب کوچک برابر نیست. دریافت اسپرد و تحمل موجودی/پوشش ریسک با پیش‌بینی ساده جهت قیمت تفاوت دارد. آستانه سرمایه و افت حساب قابل تقلید برایArzازاین منبع معلوم نیست.

cases.name: Virtu Financial — execution and technology services
cases.evidence: Same formal company exhibit, not an independent second company
cases.reported_measure: 2025commissions-net and technology services617.025millionUSD consolidated, including566.076million in executionservices; these are revenue lines, NOT additional netprofit
cases.payer_mechanism: Clients pay for agency execution, analytics and trading technology
cases.transferability: Demonstrates services income must be separated from account speculation; noArzclient demand or revenue tested
cases.costs_and_risks: Staff, technology, customer acquisition, compliance and operating costs remain
cases.fa: درآمد کارمزد و خدمات فناوری، کسب‌وکار است و نباید به اسم سود معامله شخصی معرفی شود. این نمونه اثبات تقاضای مشتری یا درآمد خدماتArzنیست.

cases.name: AQR Managed Futures Strategy Fund — Class I
cases.evidence: Selected strategy and performance sections of SEC-hosted summary prospectus
cases.return_definition: Before investor taxes, with applicable fund fees/sales charges included; not a stable monthly rate
cases.strategy_scope: Systematic long and short futures/forwards/swaps and other instruments; economic leverage and cash-equivalent collateral income described
cases.capital_access: Prospectus standard initial thresholds include5millionUSD ClassI and2500USD ClassN, with eligible exceptions; not an Arz investment recommendation
cases.payer_mechanism: Directional/relative market exposure and collateral income accrue to investors; investment-management fees are a separate manager revenue mechanism
cases.transferability: Long-short/multiasset/leverage capabilities differ from DEXspotlongonly; no secret model reconstructed
cases.fa: بازده۱۴٫۶۳درصدی۲۰۲۵در امیدنامه گزارش شده است؛ پس درآمد سرمایه‌گذاری مستند وجود دارد. ولی ابزارهای خریدوفروش استقراضی، مشتقات و اهرم این صندوق با پروژه بدون اهرم ما یکی نیست و نرخ سالانه به درآمد ماهانه ثابت تبدیل نمی‌شود.

cases.name: Sophisticated versus unsophisticated Uniswap V3 LP groups
cases.evidence: BIS WP1227 official findings/abstract, not independent reproduction of underlying trades
cases.payer_mechanism: Swap users pay fees; inventory price changes and adverse selection affect net outcome
cases.reported_finding: Skilled/sophisticated groups earned more than comparison groups in the study, including high-volatility periods
cases.identity_limit: Classification uses observed behavior and position size, not independently established natural-person identities
cases.transferability: Potentially real fee mechanism, but no equivalent100-dollar netedge established; concentrate/range/rebalancing costs and eligibility unresolved
cases.fa: پژوهشBISبرتری گروه حرفه‌ای‌تر را در نمونه بررسی‌شده گزارش می‌کند؛ به معنی سود همهLPهایا شناسایی قطعی هویت کیف‌پول‌ها نیست. درآمد کارمزد بدون محاسبه ریسک موجودی و هزینه، سود خالص محسوب نمی‌شود.

cases.name: Observed DEX arbitrage bots — Flash Boys 2.0
cases.evidence: Primary2019paper abstract about quantified transaction subsets
cases.payer_mechanism: Price inconsistencies and transaction ordering may create extractable value, while competitive gas bidding consumes part of it
cases.scope_limit: Subset revenue observations are not complete audited annual wallet profit;2019conditions are not currentmarketquotes
cases.transferability: No access/speed/capital advantage demonstrated forArz; no attack/front-running implementation provided
cases.fa: شاهد فعالیت سودجویانه آربیتراژ وجود دارد، ولی درآمد بعضی تراکنش‌ها با سود کامل سالانه یک ربات برابر نیست. رقابت هزینه و سرعت دارد؛ این تحقیق مجوز طراحی حمله به معاملات دیگران نیست.

cases.name: Cross-market cryptocurrency arbitrage evidence
cases.evidence: Accepted-paper metadata and abstract at MIT; no current trade data collected
cases.payer_mechanism: Market segmentation and different demand/capital constraints permit observed price gaps
cases.transferability: A visible international gap is not necessarily legally or operationally collectable. No service restriction or capital-control circumvention proposed
cases.fa: اختلاف قیمت مشاهده‌شده الزاماً سود قابل وصول نیست؛ جابه‌جایی سرمایه، دسترسی و اجرای هر دو سمت باید ممکن و مجاز باشد. شکاف تاریخی تضمین فرصت امروز نیست.

cases.name: Cryptocurrency factors and momentum portfolios
cases.evidence: Academic/official research abstracts; not private trader statements
cases.payer_mechanism: Risk exposure and possible delayed response motivate trend/momentum hypotheses
cases.scope_limit: Published crypto factor portfolios include long-short strategies; conventional time-series momentum spans futures/forwards. ROT90 is an original limited long-only adaptation, not replication
cases.transferability: Low-turnover research is feasible with our data, but this study must measure rather than assume its netedge
cases.fa: مقالات، انگیزه آزمون مومنتوم می‌دهند؛ بازده مقاله خریدوفروش استقراضی را نمی‌توان بهROT90فقط‌خرید نسبت داد. نتیجه انتقال باید مستقل بررسی شود.

unverified_categories: No named retail instructor, affiliate, signal seller or small personal wallet was labeled profitable without inspectable evidence. Event/statistical strategy families lack a verified small-capital individual case in this bounded review.
scope_fa: این‌ها نمونه‌های محدود با سطح شاهد مشخص‌اند، نه فهرست تمام معامله‌گران موفق. دفتر محرمانه، ثروت شخصی یا بازده قابل تقلید از روی شهرت حدس زده نشده است.
